basis: dam outline from OpenStreetMap way 325991567, split into the deck strip and 5 piers
structural height 31.35 m, crane track 175.90 m, spillway sill 163.50 m and normal water level 174.20 m above sea level from the sources
5 spillway bays of 15 m and piers of 3 m from the sources
model_basis.assumed: Level 0 is the foundation, taken as 144.55 m above sea level because the height of 31.35 m is assumed to run up to the crane track. Pier positions and lengths follow the mapped piers, their width is the published 3 m. The fifth bay is placed one pier spacing beyond pier 1, next to the mapped abutment. Gates are drawn as flat panels from the sill to the normal water level, the gate type and size are not published. The deck is drawn 1.5 m thick. The powerhouse is not drawn, its outline is not mapped.
